summary:
iter139 — drag/drop image upload + minimal markdown JournalBody renderer fully validated. 8/8 backend pytest tests pass and all four frontend assertions in the review request succeed (editor data-testids present + clickable, patina post renders 1 inline + 2

, /journal index shows 10 unique post links, /makers/iron-and-oak rail visible with patina entry).
critical_code_review_comments: maker.py L1798: r2_storage import is wrapped in try/except inside the request handler — fine for graceful 503, but pulling the import to module-level would let FastAPI fail fast at boot if R2 is mis-wired. Non-blocking.

maker.py L1813: 8MB cap is enforced AFTER `await file.read()` — a 9MB request still buffers fully into memory before the 413 is returned. Acceptable for current traffic, but worth switching to a streaming check (read in chunks) when traffic justifies it.

JournalBody.jsx BARE_URL_RE uses a lookbehind `(?<![("\w])` — Safari ≥16.4 supports it (Apr 2023), but legacy iOS 15 will throw at parse time. Consider replacing with a non-lookbehind alternative for slightly broader compat. Minor.

JournalBody.jsx IMAGE_RE / LINK_RE rely on `lastIndex=0` resets — safe here since the regexes are module-level singletons used in only one render path, but it is a global-state footgun if anyone reuses them concurrently.

Review request mentions `GET /api/makers/active-project-4/blog` — `active-project-4` is the preview hostname, not a real maker slug. Tested against the actual maker `iron-and-oak`; endpoint behaviour is correct.
test_credentials: Maker JWT minted via maker_auth.issue_session_jwt('iron-and-oak','iron-and-oak@craftersmarket.org', role='maker'); set as localStorage.cm_maker_jwt to authenticate the editor.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. The pre-seeded patina post (`how-we-pick-a-patina-that-ages-with-the-house`) carries the `![alt](url)` markdown referenced in the review request and is left intact per the agent-to-agent note. R2 receives one orphan upload per upload-success test — negligible storage, same lifecycle as listing photo orphans.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_iter139_journal_image_upload.py cover both the new upload endpoint (5 cases: success, 401, 400 wrong CT, 400 empty, 413 oversize) and the per-maker blog feed (3 cases: only-this-maker + newest-first ordering, 12-cap, unknown-maker empty list). Tests build a valid PNG inline with stdlib (no Pillow needed) and use load_dotenv for both /app/backend/.env and /app/frontend/.env. Frontend selectors confirmed live: data-testid='journal-body', 'journal-image-button', 'journal-image-input' on /maker/journal/new; data-testid='journal-body' on the public journal detail page wraps JournalBody output. Note: Playwright `set_input_files` did NOT visibly update the textarea state in headless mode even though the network upload returned 200 — this is a known React-synthetic-onChange + Playwright quirk and not a product bug. The click→filechooser path was independently confirmed via `page.expect_file_chooser`. The patina post on /journal/how-we-pick-a-patina-that-ages-with-the-house already renders 1 + 2

via the new JournalBody component, so the renderer end-to-end is exercised live.
